    SELECT 
        le.valuenum, 
        le.charttime 
    FROM 
        labevents le

        le.subject_id = 18363

        AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL 
        AND le.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE LOWER(label) IN ('hematocrit', 'hematocrit, calculated'))
)

    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(valuenum) - MIN(valuenum) <= 2 THEN 'Stable' 
        ELSE 'Unstable' 
    END AS hct_stability
FROM 
    hct_values;
